_meta.description: Seed PassThroughMarkupRule master-data records per design.md. Priority is auto-derived from rule shape (customer+category=100, customer-only=50, global=0) and used as the tie-breaker when multiple rules match. Lookup priority: customer+category > customer-only > global default. Is enforced declaratively by the Receipt/MileageEntry/PerDiem markupLookup expression.

rules.notes: Global default: +15% on all pass-through expenses across all customers and categories. Applies only when no customer-specific or category-specific rule matches.
Customer ABC (CUST-123) travel at +10% (negotiated rate per Q1 2026 contract). Beats the customer-only rule + global default for travel expenses.
Customer XYZ (CUST-456) all categories +20% (VIP client). Beats the global default but is overridden by any (CUST-456, category) rule with priority 100.
Meals: flat €2.50 markup per receipt across all customers. fixedAmount semantics: amount + €2.50 (not multiplied).
